video_title: Giannis Trade Looming? Full Offseason Primer With Marc Stein | ALL NBA PODCAST

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA calendar and offseason trade/extension rules
quotes.excerpt: the NBA calendar does not flip to 26-27 until July 1st, but teams can talk to their own free agents
quotes.quote: The actual NBA calendar does not flip to 26-27 until July 1st, but teams can talk to their own free agents and their own extension-eligible players now. It is going to be busy, man. It is going to be busy.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Anticipation of a potential Giannis Antetokounmpo trade
quotes.excerpt: there has been so much anticipation about a Giannis move. Are we finally going to get this trade?
quotes.quote: There has been so much anticipation about a Giannis move. Are we finally going to get this trade that we have been talking about incessantly? When I talk to people around the league, every team executive, every coach, every agent, Giannis' status comes up. It is always brought up. The way this thing has been trending is that it is finally going to happen in this window between the Finals and the draft.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's status as an all-time great Knick
quotes.excerpt: before these playoffs, would Jalen Brunson have been a consensus top-10 player? Now it is not a question.
quotes.quote: Before these playoffs, would Jalen Brunson have been a consensus top-10 player? I think pretty close. Now, obviously, it is not even a question. Now we are asking, is he the greatest Knick ever? And that is a legitimate discussion because of how much he has changed the culture there, the contract he took that gave them the financial wiggle room to put a good team around him.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's coaching history and impact on the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown's story is fascinating. Coaching young LeBron, getting fired by the Cavs twice, fired by the Lakers.
quotes.quote: Mike Brown's story is fascinating. Coaching young LeBron, getting fired by the Cavs twice, getting fired by the Lakers five games into a season, getting fired by the Kings, driving to the airport after meeting the media on a practice day in the middle of the season. Filling in for Steve Kerr when the Warriors won their first of two in a row in 2017. He coached that team for so much of the playoffs while Steve Kerr was out ailing. And then he is the sixth choice to coach the Knicks at best. At best, he was their sixth choice, and he ends up leading them to a championship and proving himself to be so adaptable.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's impact on Jalen Brunson's performance
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown ended up reaching Jalen Brunson as well as any coach he has ever had.
quotes.quote: Mike Brown ended up reaching Jalen Brunson as well as any coach he has ever had. And getting Jalen Brunson to play at an effective level, I think he was a little bit overrated at the start of the Finals when the Knicks took the 2-0 lead. He did not score a fourth-quarter point until Game 4 of the Finals.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks roster construction via trades
quotes.excerpt: the Knicks did not draft any of their starters, and four of their starters were acquired by trade.
quotes.quote: The Knicks did not draft any of their starters, and four of their starters were acquired by trade. And they signed Jalen Brunson away from Dallas in a blunder that the last time we went into all that, everybody said that we were talking too much Mavs.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Legler's upcoming appearance on the show
quotes.excerpt: how hard do you think coach Tim Legler is going to be on the Spurs tomorrow?
quotes.quote: How hard do you think coach Tim Legler is going to be on the Spurs tomorrow?

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks and Spurs playoff performance stats
quotes.excerpt: the Knicks led for 56 minutes in five games and the Spurs led for like 170.
quotes.quote: The stats are unreal. What is it? The Knicks led for 56 minutes in five games and the Spurs led for like 170, something like that.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's playoff win total
quotes.excerpt: the Knicks I believe have won 39 playoff games now with Jalen Brunson leading the way.
quotes.quote: The Knicks I believe have won 39 playoff games now with Jalen Brunson leading the way. That is in four postseasons. Almost 10 wins a postseason in the four years that Brunson has been there. They won eight playoff games total in the previous 21 years.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's polarizing playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: people are going to overreact to how bad this series was for Victor Wembanyama.
quotes.quote: People are going to overreact to how bad this series was for Victor Wembanyama, because look, the end of Game 2, the second half of Game 4, multiple fouls that were not even called fouls in real time that could have been flagrants. There is a lot of stuff that people are going to remember and not fondly about Victor Wembanyama's postseason.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's poor performance in the Finals
quotes.excerpt: De'Aaron Fox had such a bad Finals.
quotes.quote: De'Aaron Fox had such a bad Finals. And look, a year ago, the questions were being asked, why are you maxing out Fox if you drafted Harper? How are these guys all going to play with Castle there as well?

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's dissatisfaction with his role
quotes.excerpt: Dylan Harper was not happy with his role early on, but he kind of got with the program.
quotes.quote: Dylan Harper was not happy with his role early on, but he kind of got with the program.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of trading Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: it is not like the Spurs to just react to one series and say we are going to start trading guys.
quotes.quote: It is not like the Spurs to just react to one series and say we are going to start trading guys. They traded for Fox before they knew they were getting Harper in the draft. It is a great what if. I do not know if we are ever going to get the answer. Would they have traded for Fox if they knew they were going to get number two in the lottery and have the chance to draft Harper?

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs' young core and future trade potential
quotes.excerpt: the Spurs still have a great young core and so much room to grow.
quotes.quote: The Spurs still have a great young core and so much room to grow and a history of winning and such a strong program that it is hard to believe anything but we see them back on this stage sooner rather than later.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Bucks' coaching search and Giannis' extension
quotes.excerpt: everyone I talk to is expecting a resolution before the draft now.
quotes.quote: Everyone I talk to is expecting a resolution before the draft now. And look, Jimmy Haslam, one of the Bucks' co-owners, basically said that early in May. The Bucks introduced Taylor Jenkins as their new coach, and he said, by the draft, we either need to trade him or know he is going to do an extension. But remember, Giannis cannot do an extension until October.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Bucks' trade deadline and potential Giannis trade
quotes.excerpt: if they trade him, he is extension-eligible six months from the trade.
quotes.quote: If they trade him, he is extension-eligible six months from the trade. And if you are trading for Giannis, you need his signature on an extension six months and one minute after the trade, because you do not give up the kind of assets it is going to take to not know you could keep the guy.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Bucks' trade assets and potential moves
quotes.excerpt: the working presumption when you talk to people around the league is that the Bucks would rather move him.
quotes.quote: The working presumption when you talk to people around the league is that the Bucks would rather move him for assets to get younger and really start over, because remember, so many of Milwaukee's picks are out the door when they made the Damian Lillard trade. So that is another reason why you hear a lot about Portland, because obviously the Bucks would love to get Portland involved in this thing as one of the facilitating teams, so maybe the Bucks get back one of the picks that they used to get Lillard there.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Pistons' need for shooting and roster changes
quotes.excerpt: the Pistons, they need shooting to help Cade Cunningham. You know they are going to address that.
quotes.quote: The Pistons, they need shooting to help Cade Cunningham. You know they are going to address that. And the Pistons have, they have got Jaylen Duren as a restricted free agent. Ausar Thompson is going to be rookie-scale contract extension eligible in the fall, so or actually from July 6th through the last day of the offseason and on the eve of opening night. So the Pistons are going to be a really interesting team to keep an eye on.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Pelicans' high threshold for trading Trey Murphy
quotes.excerpt: the threshold for a Trey Murphy trade is very, very high.
quotes.quote: The threshold for a Trey Murphy trade is very, very high. And I do not know who is going to meet that price, because again, to give up the kind of assets it is going to take to not know you could keep the guy.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of trading for a star player
quotes.excerpt: it became so financially advantageous to do extensions that as one long-time agent put it to me, free agency is not a desired status.
quotes.quote: It became so financially advantageous to do extensions that as one long-time agent put it to me, as crazy as this sounds, free agency is not a desired status. Guys want extensions so they do not even have to mess with the open marketplace. If it is time to switch teams later, they will figure it out via trade. But guys generally do not want to go to free agency anymore, which is amazing to say.
